{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.92

|gr1= Map and Markers
|eff= local

|descr= Converts serialized data from [[BIS_fnc_markerToString]] into a [[Multiplayer Scripting#Locality|local]] map marker.

|s1= data call [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarkerLocal]]

|p1= data: [[String]] - serialized data

|r1= [[String]] - created [[Multiplayer Scripting#Locality|local]] marker

|x1= <sqf>"|marker_0|[3799.0110,2781.9880,0.0000]|mil_pickup|ICON|[1,1]|0|Solid|Default|1|You are here" call BIS_fnc_stringToMarkerLocal;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_markerToString]] [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarker]] [[BIS_fnc_triggerToMarker]] [[createMarker]] [[createMarkerLocal]]
}}

{{Note
|user= 7erra
|timestamp= 20190503121700
|text= The format is the following:
<code style="display: block">"{{!}}MARKERNAME{{!}}[[markerPos]]{{!}}[[markerType]]{{!}}[[markerShape]]{{!}}[[markerSize]]{{!}}[[markerDir]]{{!}}[[markerBrush]]{{!}}[[markerColor]]{{!}}[[markerAlpha]]{{!}}[[markerText]]"</code>
The delimiter for [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarker]] is the first character of the string.
}}
